scope: Read-only smallest USDC relayer service/top-up diagnosis; not a final funding component verdict

serviceRecommendation.composition: apps/rolling/start.mjs:startRollingReader injects optional funding handler into scripts/rolling-public-server.mjs:startRollingPublicServer; exact separate POST submit/GET plan-status routes before existing GET-only routing. Existing owned handler Set/drain keeps disconnected work owned.
serviceRecommendation.isolation: Trusted signer/journal closure only; never artifact origin or generated execution environment. Do not require hosted Bok/GitHub/model startup for core funding. Query-only prover /v1/node stays read-only/signature-free.
reuse: plugins/operations.mjs:fileState durable private atomic state, persistence-uncertainty latch
plugins/operations.mjs:onceAztecOperation existing L1 application in plugins/operator.mjs:ethereumSend shows raw/hash durable-before-send + reconcile-only restart
plugins/main.mjs:acquireHostedLease + serial lane for one relayer signing account
necessaryNarrowChanges: Explicit funding operation name/scope in existing once operation whitelist; retain all operator old modes.
One signer-wide nonce lane and per planHash identity including fixed chain/router/beneficiary/fee/authorization nonce; altered signature or resubmission cannot create another paid operation.
Closed request schema and finite byte/rate/outstanding limits; user never supplies arbitrary destination/RPC/method/gas ceiling/credential.
Preflight fixed router code/network, bound signatures and authorization nonce, deadline/quotes, configured gas reimbursement and maximum operator native exposure before reserving/signing.
Canonical all-leg receipt verifier supplies public sanitized status; unknown/absent remains unknown and never broadcasts again.
Existing server shutdown must stop new admission, drain bounded accepted work, retain uncertain signed state; service lease must cover all writer processes.
serviceRecommendation.doNotReuse: plugins/operations.mjs:recordedTransaction legacy helper broadcasts retained records and is unsuitable for no-replay relayer.

topups.required: Draft3 p5 additional funding follows same recovery discipline, preserves collateral/fees/Bok separation and available/reserved balances; no explicit mandatory independently selectable three-leg single-tx variants.
topups.existingFee: fundPrivateFees + recovery helpers can approve/deposit actual FEE tokens with user ETH and derive private FPC claim. This is not ETH/USDC conversion and does not solve zeroETH USDC.
topups.existingBok: Do not use legacy pluginAccountAction deposit/claim: adapter artifact and public human account/Fr.ONE path. Reuse original private Bok random commitment/secret plus prepareFundingClaim(kind:bok) and private claim; add exact existing-application action/fee bootstrap if needed.
topups.currentGap: Application claim-deposit requires collateral and optional fee/Bok; no standalone top-up action. Both aggregate router entries require all legs positive, and Design active-deposit-zero guard blocks additional full funding for a live account.
topups.recommendation: Do not loosen initial router just to claim top-up coverage. Wire narrow direct compatible-asset paths with honest ETH requirements first where appropriate; zeroETH USDC fee/Bok-only replenishment remains unqualified until explicitly supported. Never force withdrawal/redeposit merely to replenish credit.

execution: No source changes, tests, services, wallet calls or transactions.
